title: PG-16.1 Positioning, tiers, public claims, blueprint (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP16 in memev: Positioning, tiers, public claims, blueprint. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP16.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP05-03, WP16-01, WP17-02. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.13: WP16 holds the claims and the blueprint; pricing dimensions (WP16-07) were resolved by the tier decision; SO-2.13 takes the service boundary only. Boundary with SO-2.14: WP16 takes no multi-person permissions or team administration. Signed vault contract SO-14-A (cited by id only): evidence class and checked date on public claims pages; this spec holds the claims ledger and the blueprint. Signed vault contract MEM-064, MEM-065, MEM-066, MEM-137 and REV-032 (cited by id only): their price and tier values are superseded by the owner decision of 31 Oct 2026.  Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
